SPIDY Data Lab

Drop in a spreadsheet and SPIDY does the analyst's job on it — reads the file, infers every column type, cleans it, then generates the KPIs, charts, anomaly scan, correlations, forecast and the written read-out from whatever it actually found. Apex Growth Solutions — Executive Marketing Dashboard

CROSS-YEAR PERFORMANCE INTELLIGENCE · 2025–2026

An executive-level, interactive marketing analytics dashboard built for Apex Growth Solutions Inc. It processes cross-year performance data across 2025 and 2026 to deliver actionable business intelligence: dynamic KPI tracking, multi-channel ROI analysis and a full conversion-pipeline breakdown — all in a single self-contained HTML application with no backend required.

KEY FEATURES

  • Executive KPI monitoring — attributed revenue, customer acquisition cost (CAC), lead-to-win conversion rate and marketing spend
  • Dynamic year filtering — toggle 2025–2026 (all data), YTD 2026 focus, or FY 2025 full year
  • Granular aggregation — switch performance charts between monthly and quarterly view modes
  • Interactive multi-touch funnel — impressions down to closed-won deals
  • Channel ROI breakdown — donut view across Digital Ads, Content SEO, Email and Events & PR
  • Top performing campaigns table — revenue generated, ad spend and ROI %
  • Glassmorphism dark theme — obsidian background, neon cyan/purple/emerald/rose accents, animated UI
